const (

	adminPrefix = "/admin/v1"
)

func TestStudentFlowUsesCourseAndUserServices(t *testing.T) {
	taskID := uuid.NewString()
	userID := uuid.NewString()
	courseID := uuid.NewString()
	internalToken := "internal-token"
	codeStructure := json.RawMessage(`{"files":["main.go"]}`)

	course := newCourseServiceStub(t, courseTaskResponse{
		ID:                taskID,
		CourseID:          courseID,
		Status:            domain.TaskStatusActive,
		CodeStructureType: "go",
		CodeStructure:     codeStructure,
		MaxAttempts:       nil,
	})
	defer course.Close()

	fixtures := newIntegrationFixtures(t, integrationConfig{
		Course:        course,
		InternalToken: internalToken,
	})

	startURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/tasks/%s/start", apiPrefix, taskID)
	startResp := fixtures.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, startURL, nil, authHeaders(userID, "STUDENT"))
	if startResp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("start returned %d, want 200", startResp.StatusCode)
	}
	var started startTaskDTO
	decodeBody(t, startResp, &started)
	if started.Status != "IN_PROCESS" {
		t.Fatalf("start status = %q, want %q", started.Status, "IN_PROCESS")
	}
	if started.AnswerID == "" || started.SandboxID == "" || started.PreviewURL == "" {
		t.Fatalf("start payload missing fields: %#v", started)
	}
	if got := fixtures.Answers.get(started.AnswerID); got == nil {
		t.Fatalf("answer not persisted")
	}

	if events := fixtures.Publisher.Events(); len(events) != 1 || events[0].Subject != domain.SubjectTaskAnswerStarted {
		t.Fatalf("expected start event, got %#v", events)
	}

	submitURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/tasks/%s/submit", apiPrefix, taskID)
	payload := map[string]string{
		"student_task_answer_id": started.AnswerID,
		"filestorage_id":         uuid.NewString(),
	}
	body, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
	submitResp := fixtures.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, submitURL, bytes.NewReader(body), mergeHeaders(
		map[string]string{"Content-Type": "application/json"},
		authHeaders(userID, "STUDENT"),
	))
	if submitResp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("submit returned %d, want 200", submitResp.StatusCode)
	}
	var submitAnswer answerDTO
	decodeBody(t, submitResp, &submitAnswer)
	if submitAnswer.Status != domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview {
		t.Fatalf("submit status = %d, want %d", submitAnswer.Status, domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview)
	}
	if submitAnswer.FilestorageID == nil {
		t.Fatalf("filestorage_id expected")
	}
	if submitAnswer.EndedAt == nil {
		t.Fatalf("ended_at expected")
	}

	if got := fixtures.Answers.get(submitAnswer.ID); got == nil || got.Status != domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview {
		t.Fatalf("stored answer not updated to under review")
	}

	events := fixtures.Publisher.Events()
	if len(events) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 event, got %d", len(events))
	}

	if course.Calls() != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("course service called %d times, want 2 (start + submit)", course.Calls())
	}
	if header := course.LastToken(); header != internalToken {
		t.Fatalf("internal token = %s, want %s", header, internalToken)
	}
}

func TestHiddenCourseTaskRequiresRelationForStartAndSubmit(t *testing.T) {
	taskID := uuid.NewString()
	userID := uuid.NewString()
	relationID := uuid.NewString()
	course := newCourseServiceStub(t, courseTaskResponse{
		ID:                taskID,
		CourseID:          uuid.NewString(),
		Status:            domain.TaskStatusActive,
		CodeStructureType: "go",
		CodeStructure:     json.RawMessage(`{}`),
	})
	course.requiredRelationID = relationID
	defer course.Close()

	fixtures := newIntegrationFixtures(t, integrationConfig{Course: course, InternalToken: "internal-token"})
	startURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/tasks/%s/start", apiPrefix, taskID)
	directStart := fixtures.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, startURL, nil, authHeaders(userID, "STUDENT"))
	if directStart.StatusCode != http.StatusNotFound {
		t.Fatalf("hidden direct start returned %d, want 404", directStart.StatusCode)
	}
	directStart.Body.Close()

	relatedStart := fixtures.doJSONRequest(
		t,
		http.MethodPost,
		startURL+"?via_relation_id="+relationID,
		nil,
		authHeaders(userID, "STUDENT"),
	)
	if relatedStart.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("related start returned %d, want 200", relatedStart.StatusCode)
	}
	var started startTaskDTO
	decodeBody(t, relatedStart, &started)

	submitURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/tasks/%s/submit", apiPrefix, taskID)
	payload, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{
		"student_task_answer_id": started.AnswerID,
		"filestorage_id":         uuid.NewString(),
	})
	directSubmit := fixtures.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, submitURL, bytes.NewReader(payload), mergeHeaders(
		map[string]string{"Content-Type": "application/json"},
		authHeaders(userID, "STUDENT"),
	))
	if directSubmit.StatusCode != http.StatusNotFound {
		t.Fatalf("hidden direct submit returned %d, want 404", directSubmit.StatusCode)
	}
	directSubmit.Body.Close()

	relatedSubmit := fixtures.doJSONRequest(
		t,
		http.MethodPost,
		submitURL+"?via_relation_id="+relationID,
		bytes.NewReader(payload),
		mergeHeaders(map[string]string{"Content-Type": "application/json"}, authHeaders(userID, "STUDENT")),
	)
	if relatedSubmit.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("related submit returned %d, want 200", relatedSubmit.StatusCode)
	}
	relatedSubmit.Body.Close()
}

func TestStartRequiresStudentRoleFromUserService(t *testing.T) {
	taskID := uuid.NewString()
	course := newCourseServiceStub(t, courseTaskResponse{
		ID:                taskID,
		CourseID:          uuid.NewString(),
		Status:            domain.TaskStatusActive,
		CodeStructureType: "go",
		CodeStructure:     json.RawMessage(`{}`),
	})
	defer course.Close()

	fixtures := newIntegrationFixtures(t, integrationConfig{
		Course:        course,
		InternalToken: "token",
	})

	url := fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/tasks/%s/start", apiPrefix, taskID)

	resp := fixtures.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, url, nil, nil)
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusUnauthorized {
		t.Fatalf("guest status = %d, want 401", resp.StatusCode)
	}
	_ = resp.Body.Close()

	resp = fixtures.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, url, nil, map[string]string{
		"X-User-ID":   uuid.NewString(),
		"X-User-Role": "TEACHER",
	})
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Fatalf("teacher status = %d, want 403", resp.StatusCode)
	}
	_ = resp.Body.Close()

	if course.Calls() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("course service should not be called for unauthorized requests, got %d", course.Calls())
	}
}

func TestAutoReviewUpdatesStatusAndPublishesEvent(t *testing.T) {
	taskID := uuid.NewString()
	courseID := uuid.NewString()
	course := newCourseServiceStub(t, courseTaskResponse{
		ID:                taskID,
		CourseID:          courseID,
		Status:            domain.TaskStatusActive,
		CodeStructureType: "go",
		CodeStructure:     json.RawMessage(`{}`),
	})
	defer course.Close()

	fixtures := newIntegrationFixtures(t, integrationConfig{
		Course:        course,
		InternalToken: "token",
	})

	startURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/tasks/%s/start", apiPrefix, taskID)
	startResp := fixtures.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, startURL, nil, authHeaders("student-1", "STUDENT"))
	var started startTaskDTO
	decodeBody(t, startResp, &started)
	answerID := started.AnswerID

	submitURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/tasks/%s/submit", apiPrefix, taskID)
	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{
		"student_task_answer_id": answerID,
		"filestorage_id":         uuid.NewString(),
	})
	submitResp := fixtures.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, submitURL, bytes.NewReader(body), mergeHeaders(
		map[string]string{"Content-Type": "application/json"},
		authHeaders("student-1", "STUDENT"),
	))
	var startAns answerDTO
	decodeBody(t, submitResp, &startAns)

	autoUC := answer.ApplyAutoReview{
		Answers:       fixtures.Answers,
		AutoReviews:   fixtures.AutoReviews,
		ManualReviews: fixtures.ManualReviews,
		Publisher:     fixtures.Publisher,
	}
	checkedAt := time.Now().UTC()
	_, err := autoUC.Handle(context.Background(), answer.ApplyAutoReviewInput{
		StudentTaskAnswerID: answerID,
		ValidatorName:       "ms-ts-validator",
		AutoScore:           floatPtr(95.0),
		Passed:              true,
		Feedback:            strPtr("looks ok"),
		RawResult:           map[string]any{"details": []any{}},
		CheckedAt:           &checkedAt,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("auto review handle: %v", err)
	}

	stored := fixtures.Answers.get(answerID)
	if stored == nil || stored.Status != domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed {
		t.Fatalf("answer status = %v, want %d", stored, domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed)
	}

	review, err := fixtures.AutoReviews.GetByAnswerID(context.Background(), startAns.ID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("auto review not saved: %v", err)
	}
	if !review.Passed || review.ValidatorName != "ms-ts-validator" {
		t.Fatalf("review content mismatch: %#v", review)
	}

	events := fixtures.Publisher.Events()
	if len(events) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 2 events (start, auto), got %d", len(events))
	}
	last := events[1]
	if last.Subject != domain.SubjectTaskAnswerAutoApplied {
		t.Fatalf("last subject = %s, want %s", last.Subject, domain.SubjectTaskAnswerAutoApplied)
	}
}

func TestManualReviewUpdatesStatusAndPublishesEvent(t *testing.T) {
	taskID := uuid.NewString()
	course := newCourseServiceStub(t, courseTaskResponse{
		ID:                taskID,
		CourseID:          uuid.NewString(),
		Status:            domain.TaskStatusActive,
		CodeStructureType: "go",
		CodeStructure:     json.RawMessage(`{}`),
	})
	defer course.Close()

	fixtures := newIntegrationFixtures(t, integrationConfig{
		Course:        course,
		InternalToken: "token",
	})

	startURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/tasks/%s/start", apiPrefix, taskID)
	startResp := fixtures.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, startURL, nil, authHeaders("student-2", "STUDENT"))
	var started startTaskDTO
	decodeBody(t, startResp, &started)
	answerID := started.AnswerID

	submitURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/tasks/%s/submit", apiPrefix, taskID)
	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{
		"student_task_answer_id": answerID,
		"filestorage_id":         uuid.NewString(),
	})
	submitResp := fixtures.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, submitURL, bytes.NewReader(body), mergeHeaders(
		map[string]string{"Content-Type": "application/json"},
		authHeaders("student-2", "STUDENT"),
	))
	var ans answerDTO
	decodeBody(t, submitResp, &ans)

	reviewURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/task/answers/%s/review", adminPrefix, ans.ID)
	reviewPayload, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"status":      domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed,
		"final_score": 88.5,
		"feedback":    "nice",
	})
	resp := fixtures.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, reviewURL, bytes.NewReader(reviewPayload), mergeHeaders(
		map[string]string{"Content-Type": "application/json"},
		authHeaders("reviewer-1", "REVIEWER"),
	))
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("manual review status = %d, want 200", resp.StatusCode)
	}
	var reviewed answerDTO
	decodeBody(t, resp, &reviewed)

	stored := fixtures.Answers.get(ans.ID)
	if stored == nil || stored.Status != domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed {
		t.Fatalf("manual review status not applied, got %#v", stored)
	}
	mr, err := fixtures.ManualReviews.GetByAnswerID(context.Background(), ans.ID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("manual review not persisted: %v", err)
	}
	if mr.FinalScore == nil || *mr.FinalScore != 88.5 || mr.ReviewerID != "reviewer-1" {
		t.Fatalf("manual review content mismatch: %#v", mr)
	}

	ev := fixtures.Publisher.Events()
	if len(ev) != 2 || ev[1].Subject != domain.SubjectTaskAnswerReviewed {
		t.Fatalf("expected second event reviewed, got %#v", ev)
	}
}

func TestAutoReviewFailureMarksFailed(t *testing.T) {
	taskID := uuid.NewString()
	course := newCourseServiceStub(t, courseTaskResponse{
		ID:                taskID,
		CourseID:          uuid.NewString(),
		Status:            domain.TaskStatusActive,
		CodeStructureType: "go",
		CodeStructure:     json.RawMessage(`{}`),
	})
	defer course.Close()
	fixtures := newIntegrationFixtures(t, integrationConfig{
		Course:        course,
		InternalToken: "token",
	})

	startURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/tasks/%s/start", apiPrefix, taskID)
	startResp := fixtures.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, startURL, nil, authHeaders("student-3", "STUDENT"))
	var started startTaskDTO
	decodeBody(t, startResp, &started)
	answerID := started.AnswerID

	submitURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/tasks/%s/submit", apiPrefix, taskID)
	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{
		"student_task_answer_id": answerID,
		"filestorage_id":         uuid.NewString(),
	})
	submitResp := fixtures.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, submitURL, bytes.NewReader(body), mergeHeaders(
		map[string]string{"Content-Type": "application/json"},
		authHeaders("student-3", "STUDENT"),
	))
	var ans answerDTO
	decodeBody(t, submitResp, &ans)

	autoUC := answer.ApplyAutoReview{
		Answers:       fixtures.Answers,
		AutoReviews:   fixtures.AutoReviews,
		ManualReviews: fixtures.ManualReviews,
		Publisher:     fixtures.Publisher,
	}
	_, err := autoUC.Handle(context.Background(), answer.ApplyAutoReviewInput{
		StudentTaskAnswerID: ans.ID,
		ValidatorName:       "ms-css-validator",
		Passed:              false,
		Feedback:            strPtr("fail"),
		RawResult:           map[string]any{"details": []any{}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("auto review handle: %v", err)
	}
	stored := fixtures.Answers.get(ans.ID)
	if stored == nil || stored.Status != domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusFailed {
		t.Fatalf("status = %#v, want failed", stored)
	}
	ev := fixtures.Publisher.Events()
	if len(ev) != 2 || ev[1].Subject != domain.SubjectTaskAnswerAutoApplied {
		t.Fatalf("expected auto applied event, got %#v", ev)
	}
}

func TestStartHonorsMaxAttempts(t *testing.T) {
	taskID := uuid.NewString()
	maxAttempts := 1
	course := newCourseServiceStub(t, courseTaskResponse{
		ID:                taskID,
		CourseID:          uuid.NewString(),
		Status:            domain.TaskStatusActive,
		CodeStructureType: "go",
		CodeStructure:     json.RawMessage(`{}`),
		MaxAttempts:       &maxAttempts,
	})
	defer course.Close()

	fixtures := newIntegrationFixtures(t, integrationConfig{
		Course:        course,
		InternalToken: "token",
	})
	startURL := fmt.Sprintf("%s/student/tasks/%s/start", apiPrefix, taskID)
	first := fixtures.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, startURL, nil, authHeaders("student-4", "STUDENT"))
	if first.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("first attempt status = %d, want 200", first.StatusCode)
	}
	_ = first.Body.Close()

	second := fixtures.doJSONRequest(t, http.MethodPost, startURL, nil, authHeaders("student-4", "STUDENT"))
	if second.StatusCode != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Fatalf("second attempt status = %d, want 400", second.StatusCode)
	}
}

// integrationFixtures wires the HTTP server with in-memory deps.
type integrationFixtures struct {
	Router        http.Handler
	Answers       *memoryAnswerRepo
	AutoReviews   *memoryAutoReviewRepo
	ManualReviews *memoryManualReviewRepo
	Publisher     *recordPublisher
}

type integrationConfig struct {
	Course        *courseServiceStub
	InternalToken string
}

type fakeSandboxCreator struct{}

func (fakeSandboxCreator) CreateSandbox(ctx context.Context, userID, taskID, answerID string, composeConfig []byte, codeStructureTypeCode string, codeStructure []byte, starterFileStorageID string) (string, string, error) {
	return "00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000sb01", "https://stub.sandbox.localhost", nil
}

func newIntegrationFixtures(t *testing.T, cfg integrationConfig) integrationFixtures {
	t.Helper()

	if cfg.InternalToken != "" {
		cfg.Course.token = cfg.InternalToken
	}

	answers := newMemoryAnswerRepo()
	autoReviews := newMemoryAutoReviewRepo()
	manualReviews := newMemoryManualReviewRepo()
	publisher := newRecordPublisher()
	validator := validator.New()

	courseClient := courseclient.Client{
		BaseURL:       cfg.Course.URL(),
		InternalToken: cfg.InternalToken,
		HTTPClient:    cfg.Course.Client(),
	}

	answerHandler := &handlers.AnswerHandler{
		Validator: validator,
		Start: answer.StartTaskAnswer{
			TaskProvider:   courseClient,
			Answers:        answers,
			Publisher:      publisher,
			SandboxCreator: fakeSandboxCreator{},
		},
		Submit: answer.SubmitTaskAnswer{
			Answers:      answers,
			TaskProvider: courseClient,
		},
		List: answer.ListStudentAnswers{Answers: answers},
		Get: answer.GetStudentAnswer{
			Answers:       answers,
			AutoReviews:   autoReviews,
			ManualReviews: manualReviews,
		},
		Manual: answer.ApplyManualReview{
			Answers:       answers,
			ManualReviews: manualReviews,
			Publisher:     publisher,
		},
	}

	router := httpadapter.NewRouter(httpadapter.RouterDependencies{
		AnswerHandler: answerHandler,
		AdminReviewHandlers: adminhandlers.ReviewHandlers{
			ManualReview: answerHandler.ManualReview,
		},
	})

	return integrationFixtures{
		Router:        router,
		Answers:       answers,
		AutoReviews:   autoReviews,
		ManualReviews: manualReviews,
		Publisher:     publisher,
	}
}

func (f integrationFixtures) doJSONRequest(t *testing.T, method, url string, body *bytes.Reader, headers map[string]string) *http.Response {
	t.Helper()
	var reader *bytes.Reader
	if body == nil {
		reader = bytes.NewReader(nil)
	} else {
		reader = body
	}
	req := httptest.NewRequest(method, url, reader)
	for k, v := range headers {
		req.Header.Set(k, v)
	}
	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
	f.Router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)
	return resp.Result()
}

// in-memory repositories and publisher

type memoryAnswerRepo struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	records map[string]domain.StudentTaskAnswer
}

func newMemoryAnswerRepo() *memoryAnswerRepo {
	return &memoryAnswerRepo{records: map[string]domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}}
}

func (r *memoryAnswerRepo) Create(_ context.Context, answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer, maxAttempts *int) (domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	cnt := 0
	for _, a := range r.records {
		if a.TaskID == answer.TaskID && a.StudentID == answer.StudentID {
			cnt++
		}
	}
	if maxAttempts != nil && cnt >= *maxAttempts {
		return domain.StudentTaskAnswer{}, domain.ErrMaxAttempts
	}
	answer.Attempt = cnt + 1
	r.records[answer.ID] = answer
	return answer, nil
}

func (r *memoryAnswerRepo) Update(_ context.Context, answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer) error {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	r.records[answer.ID] = answer
	return nil
}

func (r *memoryAnswerRepo) GetByID(_ context.Context, id string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	answer, ok := r.records[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	cp := answer
	return &cp, nil
}

func (r *memoryAnswerRepo) GetActiveForTaskAndStudent(_ context.Context, taskID string, userID string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	for _, a := range r.records {
		if a.TaskID == taskID && a.StudentID == userID && a.Status == domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress {
			cp := a
			return &cp, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (r *memoryAnswerRepo) ListForTaskAndStudent(_ context.Context, taskID string, userID string) ([]domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	var res []domain.StudentTaskAnswer
	for _, a := range r.records {
		if a.TaskID == taskID && a.StudentID == userID {
			res = append(res, a)
		}
	}
	return res, nil
}

func (r *memoryAnswerRepo) CountForTaskAndStudent(_ context.Context, taskID string, userID string) (int, error) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	cnt := 0
	for _, a := range r.records {
		if a.TaskID == taskID && a.StudentID == userID {
			cnt++
		}
	}
	return cnt, nil
}

func (r *memoryAnswerRepo) CountForStudent(_ context.Context, userID string) (int, error) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	cnt := 0
	for _, a := range r.records {
		if a.StudentID == userID {
			cnt++
		}
	}
	return cnt, nil
}

func (r *memoryAnswerRepo) ListForStudent(_ context.Context, userID string, limit, offset int) ([]domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	result := make([]domain.StudentTaskAnswer, 0)
	skipped := 0
	for _, a := range r.records {
		if a.StudentID != userID {
			continue
		}
		if skipped < offset {
			skipped++
			continue
		}
		result = append(result, a)
		if limit > 0 && len(result) >= limit {
			break
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (r *memoryAnswerRepo) GetProgressByTaskIDs(_ context.Context, userID string, taskIDs []string) (map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress, error) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()

	allowed := make(map[string]struct{}, len(taskIDs))
	for _, taskID := range taskIDs {
		allowed[taskID] = struct{}{}
	}

	result := make(map[string]domain.StudentTaskProgress, len(taskIDs))
	latestAttempt := make(map[string]int, len(taskIDs))
	for _, item := range r.records {
		if item.StudentID != userID {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := allowed[item.TaskID]; !ok {
			continue
		}
		progress := result[item.TaskID]
		progress.TaskID = item.TaskID
		if item.Status == domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed {
			progress.HasPassed = true
		}
		if item.Status == domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview {
			progress.HasUnderReview = true
		}
		if progress.LatestAnswerID == "" || item.Attempt >= latestAttempt[item.TaskID] {
			progress.LatestStatus = item.Status
			progress.LatestAnswerID = item.ID
			latestAttempt[item.TaskID] = item.Attempt
		}
		result[item.TaskID] = progress
	}

	return result, nil
}

func (r *memoryAnswerRepo) get(id string) *domain.StudentTaskAnswer {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	if a, ok := r.records[id]; ok {
		cp := a
		return &cp
	}
	return nil
}

type memoryAutoReviewRepo struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	records map[string]domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview
}

func newMemoryAutoReviewRepo() *memoryAutoReviewRepo {
	return &memoryAutoReviewRepo{records: map[string]domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview{}}
}

func (r *memoryAutoReviewRepo) Save(_ context.Context, review domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview) error {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	r.records[review.StudentTaskAnswerID] = review
	return nil
}

func (r *memoryAutoReviewRepo) GetByAnswerID(_ context.Context, answerID string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview, error) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	review, ok := r.records[answerID]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	cp := review
	return &cp, nil
}

type memoryManualReviewRepo struct {

}

func (r *memoryManualReviewRepo) Save(_ context.Context, review domain.StudentTaskAnswerReview) error {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	r.records[review.StudentTaskAnswerID] = review
	return nil
}

func (r *memoryManualReviewRepo) GetByAnswerID(_ context.Context, answerID string) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswerReview, error) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()

	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}

	return &cp, nil
}

var (
	_ repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository = (*memoryAnswerRepo)(nil)
	_ repository.AutoReviewRepository        = (*memoryAutoReviewRepo)(nil)
	_ repository.ManualReviewRepository      = (*memoryManualReviewRepo)(nil)
)

type publishedEvent struct {
	Subject string
	Payload map[string]any
}

type recordPublisher struct {
	mu     sync.Mutex
	events []publishedEvent
}

func newRecordPublisher() *recordPublisher {
	return &recordPublisher{events: []publishedEvent{}}
}

func (p *recordPublisher) Publish(subject string, payload any) error {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	payloadMap := map[string]any{}
	if m, ok := payload.(map[string]any); ok {
		for k, v := range m {
			payloadMap[k] = v
		}
	}
	p.events = append(p.events, publishedEvent{Subject: subject, Payload: payloadMap})
	return nil
}

func (p *recordPublisher) Events() []publishedEvent {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	out := make([]publishedEvent, len(p.events))
	copy(out, p.events)
	return out
}

var _ domain.EventPublisher = (*recordPublisher)(nil)

type courseServiceStub struct {
	baseURL            string
	token              string
	resp               courseTaskResponse
	requiredRelationID string
	callCount          int
	publicCalls        int
	lastTokenSeen      string
}

type courseTaskResponse struct {
	ID                string
	CourseID          string
	Status            int
	CodeStructureType string
	CodeStructure     json.RawMessage
	ComposeConfig     json.RawMessage
	MaxAttempts       *int
}

func newCourseServiceStub(t *testing.T, resp courseTaskResponse) *courseServiceStub {
	t.Helper()
	if len(resp.ComposeConfig) == 0 {
		resp.ComposeConfig = json.RawMessage(`{"version":"3.9","services":{"app":{"image":"alpine:3.20","command":["sh","-c","while true; do sleep 3600; done"]}}}`)
	}
	stub := &courseServiceStub{
		baseURL: "http://course.test",
		token:   "internal-token",
		resp:    resp,
	}
	return stub
}

func (s *courseServiceStub) URL() string {
	return s.baseURL
}

func (s *courseServiceStub) Client() *http.Client {
	return &http.Client{Transport: s}
}

func (s *courseServiceStub) Calls() int {
	return s.callCount
}

func (s *courseServiceStub) LastToken() string {
	return s.lastTokenSeen
}

func (s *courseServiceStub) Close() {
}

func (s *courseServiceStub) RoundTrip(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	publicPath := fmt.Sprintf("/api/v1/task/get/%s", s.resp.ID)
	if req.URL.Path == publicPath {
		s.publicCalls++
		if req.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("public course access check used internal token")
		}
		if s.requiredRelationID != "" && req.URL.Query().Get("via_relation_id") != s.requiredRelationID {
			return &http.Response{
				StatusCode: http.StatusNotFound,
				Body:       io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(nil)),
				Header:     make(http.Header),
			}, nil
		}
		return &http.Response{
			StatusCode: http.StatusOK,
			Body:       io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader([]byte(`{"id":"` + s.resp.ID + `"}`))),
			Header:     http.Header{"Content-Type": []string{"application/json"}},
		}, nil
	}

	expectedPath := fmt.Sprintf("/internal/task/get-internal-task/%s", s.resp.ID)
	if req.URL.Path != expectedPath {
		return &http.Response{
			StatusCode: http.StatusNotFound,
			Body:       io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(nil)),
			Header:     make(http.Header),
		}, nil
	}
	s.callCount++
	s.lastTokenSeen = req.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token")
	if s.token != "" && s.lastTokenSeen != s.token {
		return &http.Response{
			StatusCode: http.StatusForbidden,
			Body:       io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader([]byte("forbidden"))),
			Header:     make(http.Header),
		}, nil
	}
	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"id":                       s.resp.ID,
		"course_id":                s.resp.CourseID,
		"status":                   s.resp.Status,
		"code_structure_type_code": s.resp.CodeStructureType,
		"code_structure":           s.resp.CodeStructure,
		"compose_config":           s.resp.ComposeConfig,
		"max_attempts":             s.resp.MaxAttempts,
	})
	return &http.Response{
		StatusCode: http.StatusOK,
		Header:     http.Header{"Content-Type": []string{"application/json"}},
		Body:       io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(body)),
	}, nil
}

func decodeBody(t *testing.T, resp *http.Response, dest any) {
	t.Helper()
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(dest); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode body: %v", err)
	}
}

func authHeaders(userID, role string) map[string]string {
	return map[string]string{
		"X-User-ID":   userID,
		"X-User-Role": strings.ToUpper(role),
	}
}

func mergeHeaders(groups ...map[string]string) map[string]string {
	out := map[string]string{}
	for _, g := range groups {
		for k, v := range g {
			out[k] = v
		}
	}
	return out
}

func floatPtr(v float64) *float64 { return &v }
func strPtr(v string) *string     { return &v }

type answerDTO struct {
	ID            string     `json:"id"`
	StudentID     string     `json:"student_id"`
	TaskID        string     `json:"task_id"`
	FilestorageID *string    `json:"filestorage_id"`
	StartedAt     time.Time  `json:"started_at"`
	EndedAt       *time.Time `json:"ended_at"`
	Status        int        `json:"status"`
	Attempt       int        `json:"attempt"`
	CreatedAt     time.Time  `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt     time.Time  `json:"updated_at"`
}

type startTaskDTO struct {
	AnswerID   string `json:"answer_id"`
	SandboxID  string `json:"sandbox_id"`
	Status     string `json:"status"`
	PreviewURL string `json:"preview_url"`
}

type wikiReviewResponse struct {
	Passed  bool  `json:"passed"`
	Errors  []any `json:"errors"`
	Score   int   `json:"score"`
	Details any   `json:"details,omitempty"`
}

type wikiSubmitResponse struct {
	AnswerID string             `json:"answer_id"`
	Status   string             `json:"status"`
	Review   wikiReviewResponse `json:"review"`
}

func stringFromPayload(v any) string {
	if s, ok := v.(string); ok {
		return s
	}
	return ""
}
